description: This file defines the KafkaConnectClient class which extends AwsClient, providing methods to interact with Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka Connect service. It includes method annotations for various operations like create, delete, describe, list, tag, and update connectors, plugins, and configurations, with both synchronous and asynchronous versions.

classes.name: KafkaConnectClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Kafka Connect service. It extends AwsClient and provides a set of methods, both synchronous and asynchronous, to manage Kafka connectors, plugins, configurations, and tags.

methods.name: createConnector
methods.description: Creates a new Kafka connector with specified arguments.

methods.name: createConnectorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Kafka connector.

methods.name: createCustomPlugin
methods.description: Creates a custom plugin for Kafka Connect.

methods.name: createWorkerConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a worker configuration for Kafka Connect.

methods.name: describeConnector
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific connector.

methods.name: describeWorkerConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves details about a worker configuration.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
